body: City Council Special Meeting - Community Listening Session
agenda_text:
NOTICE AND AGENDA
  FOR SPECIAL MEETING

  CITY COUNCIL
  AUGUST 22, 2024
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Mayor of the City of Norwalk has called a special meeting of the City
Council beginning at 5:00 PM on August 22, 2024 in the Norwalk Senior Center, 14040 San Antonio Drive. The
agenda for the special meeting is as follows:

  (Members of the public are entitled to speak only on the items listed. Please fill out a speaker card and
  turn it in to the Sergeant at Arms before the meeting commences.)

CALL TO ORDER/FLAG SALUTE
Mayor Rios

ROLL CALL
Theresa Devoy, CMC
City Clerk

REPORTS
1. CITY HIGHLIGHTS – No action to be taken.

2. PUBLIC SERVICES DEPARTMENT – No action to be taken.

3. PUBLIC SAFETY DEPARTMENT – No action to be taken.

4. SOCIAL SERVICES DEPARTMENT – No action to be taken.

QUESTIONS/ANSWERS – Staff will provide responses to questions in-person, on a variety of issues that may
be of importance to the speaker or the community at large. Topics that may be discussed include but are not
limited to public safety, transportation, road conditions, City's budget, utility issues, development, City
departments, animal control, housing, and parks.
 I, Theresa Devoy, City Clerk, hereby certify that the foregoing notice of special meeting was posted at City Hall
not less than 24-hours before the start of the meeting and delivered to each member of the Norwalk City Council
and to the following newspapers: Herald American, Cerritos Community News, Norwalk Patriot, and Whittier
Daily News, all on August 20, 2024.

Theresa Devoy, CMC
City Clerk

Any writings or documents provided to a majority of the City Council regarding any item on this agenda after it
has been posted will also be made available for public inspection in the City Clerk’s Department.

Public Comment: The public is encouraged to address the City Council.

Americans with Disabilities Act: In compliance with the ADA, if you need special assistance to participate in a
City meeting or other services offered by this City, please contact the City Clerk’s office, (562) 929-5720. Assisted
listening devices are available at this meeting. Ask the City Clerk if you desire to use this device. Upon request,
the agenda and documents in the agenda packet, can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to
persons with a disability. Notification of at least 12 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed
will assist the City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the
meeting or service.
